transcript.sitrep:
=== YOUR MANDATE (you won the 2028 election) ===
Platform: "America First".
You ran as a nationalist-populist: hard on China and on the border, reshore industry and protect American workers, act decisively and on your own terms rather than defer to multilateral bodies -- but avoid being dragged into another open-ended foreign war.
Your campaign explicitly promised never to: seized industry no authorization.
Your coalition will judge you on whether you honor this mandate. Handle the crisis accordingly.
===

SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot fight blind — flood the three affected cities with testing to map true spread and severity before committing to costly interventions.

actions.rationale: We cannot fight blind — flood the three affected cities with testing to map true spread and severity before committing to costly interventions.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Close the gate to affected regions immediately; protecting Americans at the border is core to our mandate and buys time.

actions.rationale: Close the gate to affected regions immediately; protecting Americans at the border is core to our mandate and buys time.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Use existing statutory authority to ramp domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators — preparing without seizing, reshoring supply chains we should never have offshored.

actions.rationale: Use existing statutory authority to ramp domestic production of PPE, tests, and ventilators — preparing without seizing, reshoring supply chains we should never have offshored.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Speak plainly to the American people every day with what we know and don't know — trust is built through honesty, not reassurance theater.

actions.rationale: Speak plainly to the American people every day with what we know and don't know — trust is built through honesty, not reassurance theater.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: Stand up a transparent national data dashboard so governors, hospitals, and citizens can see the same facts in real time.

actions.rationale: Stand up a transparent national data dashboard so governors, hospitals, and citizens can see the same facts in real time.
